market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at $120 by June 2026 would require a >300% rally from current ~$30–35 levels to a price more than double its all-time high of ~$50, an event with extremely low probability even in a strong bull market. The two-year timeframe makes such an unprecedented move highly unlikely absent catastrophic dollar collapse, which remains a tail risk far below the 6.8% implied by the market.
evidence_points: Silver’s all-time settlement high is approximately $50 (2011), so $120 is 2.4x above any prior peak.
Over the next two years, a sustained 4x move would require fundamental shocks far exceeding recent industrial or monetary demand trends.
Even aggressive inflation or geopolitical crises have never propelled silver near such levels in such a short window.
sources_consulted: CME Silver (SI) futures historical settlement prices
